notes: The subject publishes two adapter-selected ordinary interaction classes. After it unpublishes the secondary class using IEEE 1516.1-2025, a fresh IEEE 1516.2-2025 HLArequestPublications query must report exactly the still-published primary class in HLAreportInteractionPublication.HLAinteractionClassList. The object-class publication is checked unchanged. The directed report is validated against its MIM-defined NULL or populated shape without asserting an extra cross-service side effect.

requirements.statement: The federate withdraws publication of the selected secondary interaction class through the standard Unpublish Interaction Class service while retaining its publication of a distinct primary interaction class.

The publication query reports the exact remaining ordinary interaction-class list: one HLAinteractionClassList parameter containing only the still-published primary interaction class. The object-class report remains present. The directed report is checked against the exact MIM-defined NULL or populated response shape without assuming an additional interaction between publication services.
